text:
Priya Shah: quick alert — after last night's mass-merge some routes kept the old quota_multiplier for ~20-30s. repro below. anyone else notice cache/propg issues?
Marcus Li: yup, saw a blip in staging. config-applier returns success but route-cache TTL leads to stale reads.
Priya Shah: repro: `POST /v1/configs/merge` body `{"target_scope":"route","changes":[{"id":"r-99","quota_multiplier":0.6}]}` then check applier logs; apply ok but billing shows old multiplier briefly.
Ben Ortiz: this exposes our ambiguous merge semantics. We need explicit `merge_mode` (merge|replace) and CAS etag support. Also array merge semantics must be defined or arrays disallowed.
Dana Morales: console requests: show last-applied etag, diff preview, estimate affected route count and cost delta, and a dry-run toggle that returns a sampled preview.
Marcus Li: full dry-run on 100k routes is expensive. propose sampled dry-run cohorts + shadow-apply for full validation.
Priya Shah: we already emit `config.apply_success` and `config.drift_count`. Console can plot drift_count per config and alert on spikes post-merge.
Ben Ortiz: API sketch: `PATCH /v1/configs/{id}?merge_mode=merge&dry_run=true` -> 200 with preview {applied:false, preview:{changed_routes:12, sample:["r-1","r-2"]}, conflicts:[]} ; 409 on etag conflict with current state and conflicts list.
Dana Morales: UX: confirmation modal when increasing scope (user->org) with estimated affected routes and SLO impact preview. Also inline merge-conflict UI on 409.
Marcus Li: migration plan: support legacy (current) merge and new strict-mode. Default clients to strict-mode after 3 releases. Emit deprecation header.
Priya Shah: ops asks for shadow-apply first: apply to replica cluster (no routing effect) and collect metrics 24h before flip. ops-bot can schedule cohorts.
ops-bot: Shadow-apply scheduled: shadow-cohort-A on 2026-06-15T02:00:00Z using config-applier-v2 (shadow=true).
Ben Ortiz: I'll draft RFC + API spec (include etag CAS, merge_mode, dry_run, audit_id).
Marcus Li: I'll add rollback runbook skeleton: triggers = drift_count > 0.5% for 10m, 5xx increase > 2x, token-cost delta > 10% sustained.
Priya Shah: will draft console mock and telemetry queries. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll post RFC link here when ready.
Dana Morales: ping @ops-bot when RFC lands so ops can reserve shadow capacity.
Priya Shah: thanks, that's the plan. end of thread.
